title: Reviewing compliance.
bodyText: Compliance with this chapter shall be determined in light of the facts and circumstances existing at the time a decision is made or action is taken, and not by hindsight.
bodyHtml: [§517E-7]  Reviewing compliance.  Compliance with this chapter shall be determined in light of the facts and circumstances existing at the time a decision is made or action is taken, and not by hindsight. [L 2009, c 135, pt of §1]
